name: rpg-manager
description: SoyMan_ttrpg — личный менеджер настольных ролевых кампаний

scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder && npm run restore:native
scripts.dist:empty: npm run build && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.empty.json && npm run restore:native
scripts.dist:full: npm run build && npm run build-seed && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.full.json && npm run restore:native
scripts.dist:both: npm run dist:empty && npm run dist:full
